citations.quote: Her cough started in May and has never fully gone; it is worst after her bath in the evening, and the paediatrician asked us to keep her out of the bathroom as much as possible.
There is grey-green mould on the bathroom ceiling and a musty smell in the hallway that does not go away even with the windows open.
The building has had water damage before, and only an independent expert who examines the ceiling and the roof above can tell what the cause really is.
If they do nothing after the caretaker's visit, I will stop paying them and put the rent into the official deposit, as I have read is allowed.
We consider your ventilation habits to be the cause.
Nevertheless, our caretaker will visit your flat to assess the problem. We propose 8 November 2026 at 9 a.m. for access to the flat.

plan.because: Needed to establish the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The landlord's reply is not the original defect report.
Evidence of when the landlord received the defect report is needed.
Objective dated evidence of the affected locations is needed.
The supplied letter states the landlord's position and proposed inspection access. Obtain any later response or visit record if available.
Mould is reported; dated moisture and temperature observations would help assess the conditions.
Heating is not mentioned, so the silence policy presumes that branch absent for planning.
Health effects are reported; seek documented findings without assuming the cause. Follow the paediatrician's advice and address any urgent safety risk first.
An independent inspection is identified as needed and the cause remains disputed.
An official rent deposit is being considered; the communicated deadline and notice must be checked before assessing safeguards.
This is optional under the process; the landlord's letter is not correspondence from the caretaker.

questions: Has the caretaker visited, and has the landlord provided any further response or proposed repair?
Have you sent a written repair deadline to the landlord? If so, please provide it and evidence of receipt.
Has an independent inspection already taken place? If so, please provide its report.
